entries.hook: California's attorney general is suing Uber over driver misclassification; Lyft settled the same case for $272.5M this month.

market.question: Who will win the 2026 California Attorney General election?
market.rules_summary: Resolves Yes for the candidate who wins the 2026 California Attorney General election.

outcomes.name: Rob Bonta
outcomes.stance: continue the misclassification and wage-theft suit against Uber; called Uber 'a major violator'

market.p_policy_rationale: Policy book CA-attorney-general.md: Bonta row (sue, already filed, resolved within 2 years, table E) 0.70; Gates has no gig-workers row, so 0.

impact.formula: Lyft settlement $272.5M x Uber/Lyft scale 2.5 (Uber ~75% of US rideshare vs Lyft ~25%, haircut for California) = ~$680M, paid over 4 years like Lyft's = ~$170M a year. Low: 2x, $545M less ~$145M already reserved, over 4 years = $100M. High: 3x = $818M over 3 years = $270M
impact.timing: one-off for 2016-2020 conduct, paid over about 4 years from 2027

market.question: Which party will win the U.S. House?

outcomes.name: Republican Party
